/typography/roles/type.title.why: the page title under the section kicker line, 15pt bold near-black on every page

/typography/roles/type.h1.why: exhibit headings ('Exit scenarios', 'Listed flow-control peers') are 9pt bold navy

/typography/roles/type.h2.why: text panel heads ('Exit view', 'Returns') are 8pt bold near-black above 8pt bullets

/typography/roles/type.caption.why: the units line under every exhibit heading is 7pt italic slate

/typography/roles/type.footnote.why: notes directly under tables are 7pt regular slate

/typography/roles/type.source_line.why: 'Source: ...' line above the bottom rule on every page, 7pt slate

/typography/roles/type.table_header.why: column headers are 7pt bold near-black, right-aligned over numbers, no fill

/color/roles/color.surface_alt.why: pale blue-grey fill of section bands, shaded focus rows and the base-case column

/color/roles/color.emphasis.why: the burnt orange of the 'Hurdle 2.5x' dashed line on sheet 6 and the springing covenant line on sheet 5: the colour the reference uses to mark a threshold to look at

/description.summary: A dense investment-committee book: 11 x 8.5in pages packed with native tables and one or two small charts, claims stated in short bullet panels beside the exhibits.
/description.typography: Calibri throughout; 15pt bold title, 7pt bold navy caps section kicker above it, 9pt bold navy exhibit headings with a 7pt italic slate units line, 7pt table text, 8pt bullets.
/description.color: White ground, near-black ink, navy 1F3D63 as the one structural colour, mid blue and grey for secondary series, red for bad values, burnt orange for thresholds, pale blue-grey shading for focus rows.
/description.layout: 0.4in side margins, a navy rule under the title, a grey rule over the footer; two to four columns of exhibits; source line above the footer; footer with project name left and sheet number right.
/description.tables: Unfilled headers, hairline grey row rules, 1pt dark rule under header and at bottom, statistics block in italics with bold median, focus row shaded with navy bold text.
/description.motifs: Top navy rule, bottom grey rule, reference lines in charts carry their own text label.
not_seen: no legends except where two series share a chart
no claim titles: titles name the topic

/derivation_rules: A new series colour comes after navy, mid blue 6F8DB3 and grey A9B1BB in that order.
A threshold or reference line is drawn in emphasis orange or navy with its own text label.
Any new text role sits on the 7/8/9/15pt ladder; nothing below 7pt.

/typography/roles/type.bullet.why: commentary bullets in the text panels are 8pt regular near-black with about 4pt between items

/typography/roles/type.section_label.why: the section line above every title, 7pt bold navy capitals with bars between parts
